column1: # The routes of the proofs of NANUQ, and of the results of other works that they use: which numbered results each proof uses.
# Columns: label, environment, the paper proves it (1/0), results used.
# Every label is assigned here, and appears in the docstrings of the Lean results; the labels name the printed numbering
# (`nanuq:theorem36` is Theorem 36). The citations of NANUQ's own proofs are not recorded yet: every row has paper-proves 0, so that
# `route_check.py` compares no route of this paper.
# Written by hand from the sources that were read, in the libraries that prove them (lean4-phylo-network's READMEs say which). The proofs
# here reach them through the libraries' statements.
